president.title: President's Message
president.name: Mr. Sidi Said Abderrahmen
president.role: President of the Algerian Employers' Organization
president.p1: Our organization was born from the idea of serving the national economy by becoming a force of proposals and a potential for investment at a time when the country's socio-economic context is going through cyclical pressure born from the decline of oil revenues.
president.p2: We consider that in order to carry out a sustainable development program, the country must ensure financial sovereignty that can only be achieved through the diversification of the economy beyond hydrocarbons. We are not unaware of the rampant unemployment, particularly in the university environment, the alarming deterioration of household purchasing power, juvenile delinquency that was not part of our customs, as well as environmental insalubrity that has reached its peak.
president.p3: Within this organization, as informed individuals, potential economic operators acting in several wilayas have committed to combining their efforts to participate in this new momentum by reconverting themselves into development agents in the strategic sectors where the national economy is deficient.
president.p4: To this end, our organization has set up a program management led by experts. We intend to bring our vision and concepts to the attention of all public and private parties through forums that will be the subject of our permanent program.
president.p5: Our actions aim to benefit the public authorities, the university and any party acting for the same objectives in order to build together the mechanisms and structures of sustainable, harmonious and balanced development in favor of our fellow citizens.
president.p6: Inspiring reflection, informing and acting are part of the priority missions of our organization, which also intends to act outside the country, particularly in Africa to promote national products and in the West in search of partnerships and new technologies.
president.p7: We assign to this first event a roadmap mission through a battery of proposals around the reorganization of the Agriculture, Agri-food, Commerce and Environment sectors, exploiting the economic opportunities offered by the diversified natural and socio-economic context of our territories.
president.p8: Finally, we consider that our approach is fully in line with the policies of diversification of the economy beyond hydrocarbons that are essential for our country, given the instability of the global economy and the need to sustainably preserve our resources.

presentation.paragraphe_1: The Algerian Employer Organization (OPA) is an interprofessional employer organization that brings together companies from all sectors of activity, regardless of their size, structure, or line of business.
presentation.paragraphe_2: It works to represent, defend, and promote the interests of economic operators while actively contributing to the economic and social development of the country.
presentation.paragraphe_3: The OPA supports its members in their endeavors, fosters economic exchanges, and encourages investment, innovation, and value creation.
presentation.citation: « Together for a strong, modern, and competitive economy »
presentation.strategie_texte: To contribute to the revival of a new economic dynamic focused on upgrading existing investments and stimulating the creation of new investments across various branches of activity.
presentation.mission_1_texte: Encourage investment and support the growth of Algerian businesses across all sectors.
presentation.mission_2_texte: Defend the interests of economic operators before institutions and partners.
presentation.mission_3_texte: Provide information, advice, and assistance to members in their development initiatives.
presentation.mission_4_texte: Develop national and international economic relations for the benefit of businesses.
presentation.mission_citation: « A strong organization at the service of a strong economy »
presentation.valeurs_intro: The values that guide our actions, strengthen our commitment, and build our vision of a high-performing, inclusive, and sustainable economy.
presentation.valeur_1_texte: Defend the interests of our members and actively contribute to the development of a strong, stable economy that creates opportunities.
presentation.valeur_2_texte: Promote a balanced economic environment that fosters fair competition, sustainable growth, and harmonious development.
presentation.valeur_3_texte: Encourage good governance practices and value the social commitment of businesses at the service of the community.
presentation.valeur_4_texte: Our strength lies in our unity, our solidarity, and our capacity to act collectively to meet tomorrow's economic challenges.
presentation.vision_intro: An ambitious vision at the service of Algerian companies, innovation, and sustainable economic development.
vision_items: To be an employer organization of excellence, internationally recognized, acting in the interest of businesses and for their sustainable and inclusive development.
Strengthen social dialogue with social partners, the State, and development partners.
Uphold the freedom of enterprise and the market economy.
Work towards better competitiveness and sustained growth of our economy.
Act to value work and foster initiative as well as the entrepreneurial spirit.
Promote an economy driven by value creation and innovation.
presentation.objectifs_intro: The Algerian Employer Organization works to strengthen the competitiveness of businesses, foster synergies among its members, and actively contribute to the sustainable economic development of the country.
presentation.objectif_1_texte: Foster the pooling of skills, experiences, and resources among members in order to create greater collective value.
presentation.objectif_2_texte: Support businesses in improving their performance and market positioning.
presentation.objectif_3_texte: Establish a permanent framework for exchange, reflection, consultation, and proposals.
presentation.objectif_4_texte: Formulate constructive recommendations and contribute to decisions favorable to economic development.
presentation.objectif_5_texte: Design and implement monitoring, analysis, and decision-support tools.
presentation.objectif_6_texte: Support upgrading actions, encourage innovation, and promote professional excellence.
presentation.objectif_7_texte: Develop self-assessment and instill a culture of continuous improvement within companies.
presentation.objectif_8_texte: Develop a framework that promotes exchanges, cooperation, and partnerships among the organization's members.
presentation.objectif_9_texte: Participate in organizing trade fairs, exhibitions, professional meetings, and economic events.

startup.title: Start-Up
startup.subtitle: Innovation serving development
startup.p1: The interest shown by public authorities in start-ups, which now have their own fully-fledged department, is explained by the desire to involve young project leaders, particularly university graduates, in the national development effort.
startup.p2: Start-ups represent a genuine vector of innovation, job creation, and added value generation today, thereby contributing to the modernization of the national economy and the enhancement of its international competitiveness.
startup.p3: In order to accompany this dynamic, the Algerian Employers' Organization (OPA) has established a specialized commission dedicated to innovative entrepreneurship and the start-up ecosystem.
startup.p4: The mission of this commission is to encourage innovative initiatives, mentor young entrepreneurs, and foster the emergence of high-growth potential projects.
startup.p5: Start-ups can thus become a strategic lever of growth and diversification for our members wishing to participate sustainably in the development of value chains and tomorrow's economic transformations.

seminaire.title: National Seminar OPEX 2024
seminaire.subtitle: Investment in Algeria: Stakes and Outlook
seminaire.p1: Under the high patronage of the Wali of the Wilaya of Constantine, the Algerian Employers' Organization 'OPA' organized a national economic seminar on 'Investment in Algeria: Stakes and Outlook', held from February 07 to 10, 2024 at the Ahmed Bey 'Zenith' Great Hall in the Wilaya of Constantine.
seminaire.p2: This inaugural event was a moment of convergence, bringing together enlightened minds, visionary leaders, and eminent decision-makers to outline an erudite and forward-thinking economic reflection.
seminaire.p3: Speakers brilliantly articulated contemporary economic stakes, offering informed perspectives on the challenges and opportunities shaping the national and international economic landscape.
seminaire.p4: Thanks to passionate collaboration and fruitful fruitful brainstorming, this event laid the foundations for a continuous and constructive dialogue that will enlighten our path towards a more resilient and prosperous economic future.
seminaire.p5: The bonds forged and ideas shared during this event will undoubtedly guide our collective efforts towards innovative and sustainable solutions serving our country's economic development.
seminaire.p6: We are deeply grateful to all those who contributed to the success of this seminar, testifying to their commitment to advancing economic discourse and their determination to shape a brighter economic future.
seminaire.p7: As we prepare to continue this intellectual and collaborative journey, we are filled with optimism about the possibilities ahead.
seminaire.p8: With your continued support, we are convinced that this economic seminar will become an essential platform for exploring groundbreaking ideas, promoting economic dialogue, and fostering Algeria's sustainable development.

b2b.title: Algerian-Turkish Partnership & Investment
b2b.subtitle: Economic meeting between Algerian and Turkish operators
b2b.arHeading: Discussing partnership and investment opportunities between Algeria and Turkey
b2b.arp1: Organized by the Algerian Employers' Organization and under the supervision of the Turkish Embassy in Algeria and the Turkish Ministry of Trade, the largest gathering of Algerian and Turkish businessmen was held on Saturday, December 03 at the Hyatt Regency Hotel to explore partnership and investment opportunities and form a cooperation bloc between the two countries.
b2b.arp2: This meeting aims to raise the awareness of Algerian companies operating in various sectors and encourage them to integrate into global markets and benefit from mutual investment and economic cooperation opportunities.
b2b.arp3: This event also provided a platform for sharing expertise and experiences between Algerian and Turkish enterprises and exploring ways to enhance economic and commercial relations between both countries.
b2b.arp4: The President of the Organization was also a guest on the 'Debate File' program on Ennahar TV, where he explained the purpose of this gathering and the role played by the organization in strengthening economic partnership, encouraging investors to open up to international markets, and promoting Algerian products.
b2b.frp1: Organized by the Algerian Employers' Organization (OPA), under the supervision of the Turkish Embassy in Algeria and the Turkish Ministry of Trade, this economic meeting held on December 03 at the Hyatt Regency Hotel brought together a large number of Algerian and Turkish businessmen.
b2b.frp2: The main objective was to explore partnership and investment opportunities between the two countries and strengthen economic cooperation in several business sectors.
b2b.frp3: This event also enabled Algerian companies to better understand international markets and promote their products to foreign economic actors.
b2b.frp4: The President of the OPA also spoke on Ennahar TV to explain the goals of this initiative and the role of the organization in developing international economic relations.

art1.title: Creation of a public company for the development of strategic agricultural crops
art1.p1: ALGIERS – The Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development, Youcef Cherfa, announced the restructuring of the Agricultural Products Valorization Group (GVAPRO) into a Public Economic Joint Stock Company in order to develop strategic agricultural crops.
art1.p2: Speaking before the Agriculture and Rural Development Commission of the Council of the Nation, the Minister specified that this step fell within the framework of new agricultural sector guidelines and the application of instructions from the President of the Republic during the Council of Ministers on February 18, 2024.
art1.p3: This new company will be tasked with developing strategic crops, notably legumes, oilseeds such as sunflower, as well as highly resistant trees like argan and pistachio. It will also manage the intensification and multiplication of seeds.
art1.p4: A total of 174 agricultural production units representing over 114,000 hectares of arable land have been attached to this public company, with the creation of four specialized subsidiaries.
art1.p5: The EPE-SPA SODELSEC will manage the legume branch across an area of over 38,500 hectares, while the EPE-SPA SODEOL will develop oilseeds across more than 33,300 hectares.
art1.p6: The resistant tree branch will be overseen by EPE-SPA SODEAR, with 2,925 hectares dedicated to argan and 1,400 hectares to pistachio. Meanwhile, the EPE-SPA SODESEM will manage seed intensification across 21,000 hectares.
art1.p7: According to the Minister, a three-year action plan has been drawn up to achieve the goals set for strategic crop development. This program includes mobilizing water resources, acquiring modern agricultural equipment, supplying inputs, and planting resistant trees.
art1.p8: This new vision aims to better exploit Algeria's agricultural potential through the creation of specialized production units and the strengthening of strategic value chains.
art1.h2: Agricultural production units replace pilot farms
art1.p9: The Minister also announced the restructuring of pilot farms into state-owned agricultural production units. These units will specialize in strategic crops, notably legumes, seeds, oilseeds, and resistant trees.
art1.p10: This approach will preserve the agricultural vocation of these farms while helping to increase national production, reduce the import bill, and reinforce national food security.
art1.p11: The Ministry of Agriculture currently records 861 agricultural cooperatives across national territory, including 148 specializing in animal production, 55 in crop production, and 658 in diverse agricultural and rural activities.

art2.title: Investment in Algeria: stakes and outlook debated in Constantine
art2.p1: In a context aimed at boosting national production across different regions of the country, a seminar was held in Constantine under the slogan 'Investment in Algeria: Stakes and Outlook'.
art2.p2: This meeting, organized under the auspices of the Algerian Employers' Organization (OPA) in collaboration with the Wilaya of Constantine, brought together investors, economic operators, representatives of public and private companies, artisans, start-ups, and economic partners from several regions of the country.
art2.p3: Alongside the seminar, a major exhibition was organized at the Ahmed Bey Zenith with the participation of over 72 exhibitors representing various business sectors.
art2.p4: Following official inauguration, the Wali of Constantine, Mr. Abdelkhalek Sayouda, accompanied by OPA President Mr. Abderrahmene Sidi Said and local authorities, visited the various booths and spoke with representatives of innovative and high-performing companies.
art2.p5: Represented sectors covered agriculture, industry, tourism, services, and new technologies, showcasing national economic production and innovation capacities.
art2.p6: Exhibitors expressed keen interest in this event, which aligns with the dynamic driven by state authorities to stimulate national production, curb imports, and foster national self-sufficiency.
art2.h2_1: A forum dedicated to major economic challenges
art2.p7: On the sidelines of the exhibition, several panels and conferences were dedicated to strategic themes such as food security, industrial development, agri-food, and promoting the 'Made in Algeria' label.
art2.p8: These discussions helped highlight investment opportunities and ways to further boost national economic competitiveness.
art2.p9: OPA President Mr. Abderrahmene Sidi Said emphasized that this meeting represents an essential opportunity to identify difficulties encountered by investors and economic operators in their daily activities.
art2.p10: He also recalled the strategic importance of the agri-food industry as a natural outlet for agricultural production, a sector that has experienced remarkable growth in recent years.
art2.p11: For instance, Algerian olive oil has gradually established itself in international markets thanks to recognized premium quality, opening up promising new export horizons.
art2.p12: OPA also highlighted the need to develop sheep and cattle rearing branches to reduce reliance on imported meat and milk.
art2.p13: The organization expressed its readiness to accompany breeders through concrete support and guidance initiatives aimed at bolstering national production and gradually achieving self-sufficiency.
art2.p14: According to Mr. Sidi Said, Algeria possesses considerable assets in this area, particularly thanks to premium livestock quality and the solid experience of its breeders, providing a sound basis for sustainable sector development.
art2.author: By Amine B.

art3.title: Moment of Silence
art3.p1: The Algerian Employers' Organization observes a moment of silence in memory of our martyrs, whose sacrifice we will never forget, nor the massacres of October 17, 1961, following orchestrated and inhumane crimes perpetrated against the Algerian people in their struggle for freedom, dignity, and independence.
art3.p2: On this day of remembrance and contemplation, we pay tribute to all those who gave their lives so that a free and sovereign Algeria may live.

art4.title: Agriculture: implementation of a daily price index
art4.p1: ALGIERS – The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development announced the implementation of a daily price index for agricultural products, intended for professionals and consumers alike.
art4.p2: This initiative aims to improve market transparency and provide reliable, updated, and easily accessible information regarding price trends for key agricultural goods.
art4.p3: The index is published daily on the official Ministry website as well as its digital communication platforms and social media channels.
art4.p4: It includes current prices for 18 strategic agricultural products, notably vegetables, red and white meats, milk, eggs, and other everyday consumer goods.
art4.p5: Collected data covers major cities and urban centers across the country to offer a comprehensive overview of agricultural markets nationwide.
art4.p6: This allows producers, merchants, and consumers to monitor price fluctuations and benefit from trustworthy benchmarks for their daily operations.
art4.p7: The index also includes a comparative price analysis in certain foreign cities and countries hosting a substantial Algerian community abroad.
art4.p8: This comparison will provide a better reading of domestic price positioning relative to other international markets.
art4.p9: To expand access to this information, the Ministry announced that the price index will also be broadcast every Thursday on national television channels.
art4.p10: This measure will allow more citizens to access agricultural price information and follow regular market trends.
art4.p11: According to the Ministry, launching this system falls within its communication plan aimed at providing dependable, verified, and transparent information serving sector professionals and consumers.

art5.title: The time has come, the opportunity is here!
art5.p1: The Algerian-German Chamber of Commerce and Industry (AHK Algeria) organized the second edition of its 'Rencontres Market' event, a day dedicated to economic brainstorming and investment opportunities between Algeria and Germany.
art5.p2: This meeting brought together numerous business leaders, investors, and economic operators from both countries around a common goal: strengthening bilateral economic ties and encouraging concrete cooperation projects.
art5.p3: The event allowed participants to exchange views on growth prospects, partnership opportunities, and promising sectors likely to further boost investments between both economies.
art5.p4: The primary objective of this economic networking day was to stimulate joint investments and expand trade exchanges between Algeria and Germany.
art5.p5: Discussions focused on ways to develop sustainable partnerships capable of generating added value, transferring know-how, and supporting robust economic growth.
art5.h2_2: An optimistic outlook for the national economy
art5.p6: As guest of honor at this meeting, the President of the Algerian Employers' Organization, Mr. Sidi Said Abderrahmane, expressed his satisfaction regarding the evolving business and investment climate in Algeria.
art5.p7: He emphasized that ongoing reforms and new economic guidelines are gradually creating a much more favorable environment for domestic and foreign investors.
art5.p8: According to him, Algeria now possesses substantial assets and an industrial potential capable of supporting sustainable growth and further elevating the country's standing on the international economic stage.
art5.p9: The OPA President also reaffirmed the organization's willingness to participate fully in any economic cooperation or international partnership initiative likely to contribute to national economic development.
art5.p10: Through this proactive approach, the Algerian Employers' Organization intends to accompany investors, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster brand-new economic opportunities serving sustainable growth and employment.
art5.quote: « The time has come, the opportunity is here to build solid partnerships and promote a competitive, innovative Algerian economy open to the world. »

art6.title: Dynamic aspect of real change towards the hope of a great challenge…
art6.p1: Algeria continues its robust economic recovery and increasingly confirms its strong attractiveness among foreign investors and international partners.
art6.p2: During his visit to the DJAZAGRO International Food Production Exhibition, the President of the Algerian Employers' Organization, Mr. Sidi Said Abderrahmane, noted a significant return of foreign investor confidence in the Algerian market.
art6.p3: Several exhibitors and companies from Asia, Europe, and other regions of the world showed growing interest in the investment opportunities offered by Algeria.
art6.p4: This enthusiasm is notably explained by bold ongoing reforms, an improved business climate, and numerous concrete measures designed to encourage productive investments.
art6.p5: Participants highlighted the wonderful incentives offered to project leaders as well as growth prospects in strategic sectors such as agri-food, industry, agriculture, and services.
art6.h2_2: A new vision for the future
art6.p6: This positive evolution also reflects an affirmed desire to build an economy that is more diversified, competitive, and firmly oriented towards innovation and value creation.
art6.p7: According to the OPA President, the encouraging signals observed at this trade show demonstrate genuine positive change and renewed confidence in the country's economic capacities.
art6.p8: Algeria possesses outstanding major assets today: a strategic geographical location, substantial resources, a flourishing market, and growing openness to mutually beneficial international partnerships.
art6.h2_3: Algeria, a major economic player in Africa
art6.p9: Thanks to its economic potential and strategic standing between Africa, Europe, and Asia, Algeria is called upon to play a leading role in regional and continental trade and investment projects.
art6.p10: For the Algerian Employers' Organization, this dynamic must be consolidated to make Algeria a veritable economic and industrial hub capable of attracting more investments and contributing actively to the sustainable development of the African continent.
art6.quote: « Algeria moves forward with great confidence into a brand-new stage of its economic development, driven by investment, innovation, and international partnerships. »

art7.title: Djelfa: 'Dahbia' olive oil awarded in Switzerland
art7.p1: Algerian olive oil 'Dahbia', produced in Aïn Oussera (Djelfa), won another prestigious gold medal at the international organic olive oil competition held in Geneva, Switzerland.
art7.p2: This distinction once again confirms the absolute excellence of Algerian agricultural goods and their wonderful ability to compete with the world's finest productions.
art7.p3: This award comes in addition to five previous gold medals won at international competitions held notably in Japan, Germany, Italy, and the United Arab Emirates.
art7.p4: Thanks to these outstanding performances, the 'Dahbia' brand has gradually established itself in international markets as a gold-standard reference for premium organic olive oil.
art7.p5: According to Mr. Hakim Aliliche, founder of the brand, each competition reposes on highly stringent criteria, including laboratory chemical analyses, technical evaluations, and the flawless expertise of international taste juries.
art7.p6: These rigorous procedures ensure that only oils meeting the very highest quality standards can aspire to win an international distinction.
art7.p7: His objective remains to preserve this pristine level of excellence constantly and pursue continuous improvement efforts to maintain the product's premium competitiveness in foreign markets.
art7.p8: During the very same year, 'Dahbia' olive oil also secured four silver medals at international competitions organized in Tokyo, Oslo, Athens, and Turkey.
art7.p9: These remarkable results testify to the wonderful consistency and exceptional quality of this Algerian production recognized far beyond national borders.
art7.p10: Honored by the President of the Republic during the National Agriculture Assizes, Mr. Hakim Aliliche considers these outstanding distinctions as an added motivation to promote Algerian olive oil worldwide.
art7.p11: His magnificent experience is an inspiring source of guidance today for many farmers who regularly seek his professional advice to develop their very own agricultural projects.
art7.p12: Specializing in organic olive growing for over twenty years, he transformed more than 40 hectares in Aïn Oussera into a modern farming estate counting nearly 15,000 olive trees and utilizing eco-friendly water-saving irrigation techniques.
art7.quote: « An outstanding Algerian success story that promotes our agriculture, our pristine know-how, and the magnificent potential of our producers in international markets. »
